content.comment_body: Hello everyone, A while back, I installed [product_name] [version_no] on my Mac and created some network projects (.snp). Everything was working smoothly on my PC and with the connected [product_name] modules. Recently, I updated my Mac to Ventura 13.4.1. Now, when I try to open my previous projects, the software recognizes the project folder but won't open them anymore. I believe updating to the version with SP1 might resolve this, but I'm unable to find where to download it. Could you help me locate the correct download? Best regards, [user_name]

[company_name] has removed the website for downloading SP1 of [product_name] [version_no]. Currently, there is only a download available for upgrading to [product_name] [version_no]. Instructions for downloading and installing the upgrade are available, but the patch for the previous version is no longer offered.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces software incompatibility after upgrading to MacOS Ventura 13.4.1; their older [product_name] projects can't be opened, even though the software recognizes the folder. The user believes that a service pack could resolve the issue but cannot find a download. Another user confirms that the patch is unavailable, and only an upgrade to a newer version is offered.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to continue accessing and working with existing [product_name] projects after OS upgrades by locating and applying required software patches or updates.
